name: University of Oxford
summary: Oxford has no clear founding date, but teaching existed there in some form by 1096. Undergraduates belong to one of 32 colleges and permanent private halls that admit them. Applications go through UCAS by a strict 15 October deadline, most courses require an admissions test, and shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

internationalTuition.notes: Overseas course fees for 2027 entry vary by course; Economics and Management is £46,210 a year.

housing.value: Students live in college accommodation, which is often heavily subsidised; 2026-27 accommodation and meals cost roughly £6,877–£9,725 for 175 days depending on the college.

schools: 36 colleges and 3 societies; 32 colleges and permanent private halls admit undergraduates

admissionStats.notes: "Admitted" here counts offers; 3,302 students were admitted.

outcomes.measure: HESA Graduate Outcomes, 15 months after leaving: high-skilled employment or further study; median salary.
outcomes.employmentRate: 93% in high-skilled work or further study

admissionProcess.detail: Submit by 6pm UK time on 15 October 2026 for 2027 entry.
Most courses require one — e.g. TARA for Economics and Management, TMUA for Computer Science.
Applicants are shortlisted using the application and test result; shortlisted candidates are interviewed.

feeBreakdown.item: Overseas course fee — Economics and Management

feeBreakdown.notes: Food £325–£560, accommodation £880–£1,025, personal £165–£320, social £50–£135, study £35–£95 a month.
